game.title: The Witcher 2: Assassins of Kings Enhanced Edition

roadmap.title: Prologue
roadmap.description: Fight through the La Valette siege: ballista shot, 10-kill streak, gambling and a few early firsts.

roadmap.title: Chapter 1: Flotsam
roadmap.description: Do the Flotsam side quests, craft and brew, sneak Loredo's garden and kill the Kayran; choose a path at the end.

roadmap.title: Chapter 2
roadmap.description: Path-specific camp tasks, trolls, ability trees, Miser farm, the Draug and the siege of Vergen.

roadmap.title: Chapter 3 and Epilogue
roadmap.description: Pest Control, solstice shrine, Guru farm, the Summit of Mages decisions, the dragon and Letho.

roadmap.title: Insane run
roadmap.description: Repeat the game on Insane, taking the other path, for Madman and the remaining choices.

achievements.description: Finish the Prologue.
achievements.summary: Finish the Prologue.

steps.text: Play through the Prologue until @npc{Vernon Roche}, Triss and Geralt board the Blue Stripes ship after the dungeon escape.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 1.
achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 1.

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 1 main quests in Flotsam and its forests, then pick a path in @mechanic{At a Crossroads} to leave for Aedirn.
For Iorveth's path, return his sword to Iorveth when Roche and Letho spring the ambush; any other reaction puts you on Roche's path.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 2.
achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 2.

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 2 main quests on your chosen path until the siege of @loc{Vergen} ends and you head for Loc Muinne.

achievements.description: Finish the game while playing at the Insane difficulty level.
achievements.summary: Finish the whole game on Insane difficulty.

guide.context: Insane is Hard difficulty with permadeath. Chapter 1, with the Letho fight and the Kayran, is the most dangerous stretch.

steps.text: Turn off the difficult QTE option in Options, Gameplay. Doing so does not void the achievement.
Start a new game on Insane. Death deletes every save of that playthrough, so quicksave after each fight.
Reload whenever you take damage from a heavy hitter such as the @enemy{Kayran}, a golem or a bullvore, and when health drops low with more attacks coming.
Keep @mechanic{Quen} active and stay out of the Chapter 2 fog unless a quest sends you in.
Finish the game; the achievement unlocks at the start of the credits.

achievements.description: Finish the game at any difficulty level.
achievements.summary: Finish the game on any difficulty.

steps.text: Play through the Epilogue and decide Letho's fate to reach the end of the game.

achievements.displayName: Oh My God! You Killed the Kayran! You Bastards!
achievements.description: Defeat the Kayran.
achievements.summary: Kill the Kayran in Chapter 1.

steps.text: Fight the @enemy{Kayran} in its lair, cut off its tentacles and kill it.
Use the @mechanic{Yrden} sign to trap its tentacles so they can be cut.

achievements.description: Defeat the Draug.
achievements.summary: Kill the Draug that ends the Chapter 2 vision quest.

steps.text: Finish the vision quest through the mist and defeat the Draug in the final fight.
Use @mechanic{Aard} to stun it, then attack while it is helpless.

achievements.description: Kill the dragon at the end of the game.
achievements.summary: Kill the dragon Saesenthessis at the end of Chapter 3.

guide.context: Available on Roche's path; Iorveth's path ends with the Dragonheart outcome instead.

steps.text: Fight the dragon, then choose to kill it when it is grounded instead of walking away.

achievements.description: Craft a suit of armor from elements of the kayran's carapace.
achievements.summary: Craft a suit of armor from the Kayran's remains.

guide.context: The materials are costly; save before paying and reload afterwards if you do not want the armor.

steps.text: Loot the Kayran Skin from the corpse and hand in the quest @mechanic{A Matter of Price} to receive the Kayran armor diagram.
Gather Robust Cloth x14, Hardened Leather x6, Twine x8 and 375 Orens, then have a craftsman make the armor.

achievements.description: Cut off a tentacle using the kayran trap.
achievements.summary: Cut off a Kayran tentacle with the Kayran trap.

guide.context: Save before the fight so you can reload and skip the trap afterwards.

steps.text: Get the iron frame in Loredo's garden, then buy the Kayran trap diagram from Cedric for 276 Orens.
Craft the trap with Oil x2, Iron Ore x1 and Silver Ore x1 plus the frame.
In the Kayran fight, place the trap on one of the two marked spots so the beast strikes it and loses a tentacle. Reload if it misses.

achievements.description: Achieve character level 35.
achievements.summary: Reach character level 35.

guide.context: Farming the same enemy gives diminishing returns.

steps.text: Get to level 34 before you start the quest @mechanic{A Summit of Mages}, since it cannot be undone.
Farm the Order of the Flaming Rose knights at their camp outside Loc Muinne; they respawn. This works only when Anais was taken to John Natalis rather than King Radovid.
With a Witcher 1 save that keeps them friendly, farm the gargoyles of the Gargoyle contract instead without solving the rune puzzles.
Finish the dragon fight for the last level.

achievements.description: Acquire the Mutant ability.
achievements.summary: Learn the Mutant ability from the alchemy tree.

guide.context: You can repeat this for the other two tree achievements from the same save.

steps.text: Reach level 15 and keep 8 unspent talent points after spending 6 in the base tree.
Save, put the points into the alchemy tree down to Mutant, collect the achievement, then reload.

achievements.description: Acquire the Sense of Magic ability.
achievements.summary: Learn the Sense of Magic ability from the mage tree.

steps.text: With 8 spare talent points, save, then buy abilities down the magic tree to Sense of Magic.
Collect the achievement, then reload.

achievements.description: Acquire the Combat Acumen ability.
achievements.summary: Learn the Combat Acumen ability from the swordsmanship tree.

steps.text: With 8 spare talent points, save, then buy abilities down the swordsmanship tree to Combat Acumen.
Collect the achievement, then reload.

achievements.description: Achieve character level 10.
achievements.summary: Reach character level 10.

steps.text: Keep doing quests and fighting until you reach level 10, which happens in Chapter 1.

achievements.description: Hire a craftsman to create an item.
achievements.summary: Have a craftsman make an item for you.

steps.text: Gather crafting materials, then give Berthold Candeleria in the Flotsam non-human district an item to craft, such as the silver sword.

achievements.description: Use alchemy to brew five potions or oils.
achievements.summary: Brew five potions, oils or bombs.

guide.context: Bombs count, so Grapeshot bombs for the nekker contract help.

steps.text: Brew five items one at a time from the alchemy menu; stacks made in one action count once.

achievements.description: Kill more than one opponent using a single exploding bomb.
achievements.summary: Kill two or more enemies with one bomb.

steps.text: Enter the nekker cave behind the waterfall near Flotsam with Grapeshot bombs.
Throw a Grapeshot into a group of nekkers so at least two die.

achievements.description: Drink one potion.
achievements.summary: Drink one potion.

steps.text: Meditate, open Drink Potions and drink any potion, such as Cat.

achievements.description: Collect 10000 orens.
achievements.summary: Hold 10,000 Orens at the same time.

steps.text: Keep your money and sell gear as you upgrade; sell harpy parts for more.
At the Visionary in Chapter 2, kill the endless harpies and sell their feathers (9 Orens each) and other parts (4 Orens each).
Or arm wrestle Adam Pangratt in the Kaedweni camp repeatedly with the maximum bet for 100 Orens each.
Check your total until the Orens in your pouch reach 10,000.

achievements.description: Enhance abilities using mutagens at least five times.
achievements.summary: Use mutagens to enhance abilities five times.

guide.context: Mutagen placement is permanent, so reload your earlier save afterwards.

steps.text: Collect at least five mutagens and unlock abilities that accept mutagen slots, such as Fortitude or Combat Acumen.
Save, place five mutagens, then reload after the achievement.

achievements.description: Kill 500 foes.
achievements.summary: Kill 500 enemies.

steps.text: Fight through the game; harpy farming at the Visionary speeds this up.

achievements.description: Perform three successful ripostes in a row.
achievements.summary: Land three ripostes in a row.

steps.text: Learn the @mechanic{Riposte} ability, lock onto an enemy and hold block.
When the sword icon flashes, press quick attack. Do it three times in a row, nekkers in the waterfall cave are a good place.

achievements.description: Kill a foe by deflecting his own arrow at him.
achievements.summary: Kill an archer with an arrow you deflected back at them.

guide.context: Reload afterwards to refund the points.

steps.text: Learn @mechanic{Arrow Redirection} by spending two talent points.
Lock onto an archer and hold parry so their arrows fly back at them until they die.

achievements.description: Kill three foes at once by performing a group finisher.
achievements.summary: Kill three enemies at once with a group finisher.

steps.text: Learn @mechanic{Combat Acumen} and fill the adrenaline bar.
Gather three human enemies close together and trigger the finisher. Monsters only die one at a time.

achievements.description: Kill 10 foes in a row without losing any Vitality.
achievements.summary: Defeat ten foes consecutively while your Vitality stays untouched.

steps.text: In the Prologue, after the ballista, go back to Foltest on the castle walls and let his men fight the La Valette knights.
Save, kill knights without being hit and reload if you take damage; the count carries across reloads.

achievements.description: Hit Count Etcheverry using the ballista.
achievements.summary: Shoot Count Etcheverry with the ballista in the Prologue.

steps.text: Save when Foltest asks you to shoot Count Etcheverry with the ballista.

Aim so the middle of the crosshair sits on the soldier to the right of the Count (the Count wears two feathers and stands on the left), at about 1.5 degrees. Geralt announces the angle aloud when the shot is right; reload if you miss.

achievements.description: Successfully sneak through Loredo's garden and find the component of the kayran trap.
achievements.summary: Sneak through Loredo's garden and take the iron frame without being caught.

guide.context: Being detected ends the garden and fails the achievement.

steps.text: After midnight at Loredo's residence, let Roche distract the arbalist, then save.
Sneak through the garden without being detected and take the iron frame from the chest in the isolated storage area.
Listen at the window to Síle and Loredo, then return to Roche.

achievements.description: Find all additional information about the insane asylum's history.
achievements.summary: Find all four hospital files in the burned asylum.

steps.text: Take @mechanic{In the Claws of Madness} from Cedric and go to the burned asylum south of Flotsam.
Open the chests holding Hospital Files I to IV; the last one is in the corner chest after you deal with the Nilfgaardian soldier wraith.

achievements.description: Defeat all opponents in the Kaedweni arena.
achievements.summary: Win every fight in the arena tournament.

guide.context: Roche's path only.

steps.text: Help Sven beat Letande Avet in the arena in @mechanic{The Butcher of Cidaris}; Proximo then offers the tournament.
Win all four fights in the afternoon. Ves is the last opponent.

achievements.description: Seduce Ves.
achievements.summary: Seduce Ves.

guide.context: Roche's path only.

steps.text: After the arena tournament, visit Ves at Roche's encampment.
Answer her with three agreeable lines in order: the one about using this opportunity, then "She's both brave and beautiful.", then "I like that idea."

achievements.description: Brew the ostmurk potion.
achievements.summary: Brew the ostmurk potion.

steps.text: During the quest The Kayran, collect the mucus with Triss; she gives the formula.
Brew the potion with Rebis, Aether and Fulgar. Fulgar is sold by Cedric or comes from endrega embryos.

achievements.description: Tour the camp with Zyvik.
achievements.summary: Tour the Kaedweni camp with Zyvik.

guide.context: Roche's path only.

steps.text: After returning to the camp, follow Zyvik and do not ask him to take you to the king.
The achievement unlocks after the tied-up scout, before he takes you to the king.

achievements.description: Make a choice about Henselt's fate.
achievements.summary: Refuse to let Roche kill Henselt.

guide.context: Roche's path only. You can reload afterwards.

steps.text: At the end of Chapter 2 in Philippa's house in Vergen, defeat Henselt and his men.
When Roche wants to kill Henselt, tell him not to.

achievements.description: Spare all trolls in the game.
achievements.summary: Spare all three talking trolls.

guide.context: The hostile troll in the cliffs near Roche's camp does not count. Do not beat Sendler at dice before this quest.

steps.text: Chapter 1: accept Troll Trouble, ask the bridge troll why he drinks, and kill his wife's murderer Dmitri.
Beat Sendler at dice poker and ask for the She-Troll's head, then give it to the troll.
Chapter 2: save the she-troll from Adam Pangratt and send her to the drunken troll to repay him.
Take Triss's bandana from him.

achievements.description: Kill all the trolls in the game.
achievements.summary: Kill all three talking trolls.

guide.context: The hostile troll in the cliffs near Roche's camp does not count.

steps.text: Chapter 1: in Troll Trouble, fight the bridge troll under the broken bridge and finish him with "Not good enough".
Chapter 2: kill the she-troll on the road to Vergen.
Kill the drunken troll after telling him his wife is dead.

achievements.description: Sneak through the lower camp without raising the alarm.
achievements.summary: Sneak through the lower Kaedweni camp without being noticed.

guide.context: Iorveth's path only.

steps.text: On Iorveth's path, in Where Is Triss Merigold?, save before entering the lower camp.
Wait for patrols to pass; if the cook sees you near the end, use @mechanic{Axii} on him.
Reach the far exit without raising the alarm.

achievements.description: Help Roche in Chapter 3.
achievements.summary: Help Roche free Anais from Dethmold instead of continuing the search for Triss.

guide.context: Roche's path only.

steps.text: In Chapter 3, choose to help Roche free Anais rather than keep searching for Triss.
Do not speak to Shilard at the Nilfgaardian embassy.
Finish For Temeria! and Of His Blood and Bone, and take Anais to John Natalis.

achievements.description: Relive memories in a vision.
achievements.summary: Complete every memory of the dead assassin Auckes during the ritual Dethmold performs.

guide.context: Roche's path only. Stepping on a trap, being detected in the sneak phase or dying in the last phase fails the vision.

steps.text: Purchase the Gadwall formula from the vendor by the tent, brew the potion and drink it, then speak to Dethmold again.
In the vision, kill the harpies along the furrow, avoid the traps in the hideout and then take down the single guard who patrols in a straight line.
Meet the other assassin, kill all the guards, then fight Geralt without dying.

achievements.description: Help Iorveth find the dagger.
achievements.summary: Free Philippa Eilhart and finish The Spellbreaker quest.

guide.context: Iorveth's path only.

steps.text: In Chapter 3, choose Philippa instead of searching for Triss.
Solve the diagram puzzle from Philippa's notes (the right one is randomized) and beat the elemental.

achievements.description: Make a choice about Síle.
achievements.summary: Let Síle die in the unstable portal.

steps.text: At A Summit of Mages, run up Síle's tower and do nothing to her Megascope so she dies.

achievements.description: Make a choice about Síle.
achievements.summary: Stop Síle from being killed by her malfunctioning portal.

steps.text: At A Summit of Mages, run up Síle's tower (the stairs collapse) and pull out the damaged crystal from her Megascope.

achievements.description: Make a choice about the dragon.
achievements.summary: Save Saskia during the dragon encounter.

guide.context: Iorveth's path only.

steps.text: On Iorveth's path, finish The Spellbreaker so Philippa's dagger is available.
Complete the dragon fight to save Saskia.

achievements.description: Make a choice about Letho.
achievements.summary: Kill Letho in the Epilogue.

guide.context: A good steel sword and armor make this much easier.

steps.text: In the Epilogue, choose the dialogue line about it being time to finish this, then defeat Letho.

achievements.description: Make a choice about Letho.
achievements.summary: Let Letho go in the Epilogue.

steps.text: In the Epilogue, tell Letho to go somewhere far away.

achievements.description: Finish all quests involving the destruction of monster nests.
achievements.summary: Finish every monster nest contract in one playthrough.

steps.text: Chapter 1: destroy four nekker nests with Grapeshot bombs and two endrega nests (open the three cocoons, then kill the queen).
Chapter 2: on Roche's path burn the nine corpses for the Rotfiend contract; on Iorveth's path complete the Harpy contract and its Harpy Queen.
Chapter 3: do the Gargoyle contract by solving the three rune rooms. The runes are Animal, Time, Death and Sky; the poem in each room gives the order. Be at full health.
Hand in the Gargoyle contract to Bras of Ban Ard.

achievements.description: Win an arm wrestling match, a dice poker game and a fist fight.
achievements.summary: Win one arm wrestling match, one game of dice poker and one fist fight.

guide.context: Turn off difficult QTEs or the fist fight is very hard.

steps.text: At the Flotsam inn, win one arm wrestle upstairs and one dice poker game and one fist fight in the basement.

achievements.description: Intimidate someone.
achievements.summary: Intimidate someone in dialogue.

steps.text: Pick the red Intimidate option when talking to someone, such as the soldier robbing peasants in the Prologue.

achievements.description: Roll five-of-a-kind at dice poker.
achievements.summary: Win a dice poker game with five of a kind.

guide.context: This takes luck; reload after losses and save after wins.

steps.text: Challenge the camp soldier in the Prologue or an inn player in Flotsam and keep the most common number.
Re-roll the rest until all five dice match; the five of a kind must win the game.

achievements.description: Reach the Epilogue of the game.
achievements.summary: Reach the Epilogue of the game.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 3 by deciding the dragon's fate to reach the Epilogue.

achievements.description: Find the Summer shrine.
achievements.summary: Bow at the Summer solstice shrine in Chapter 1.

steps.text: Go southeast beyond the bridge troll and up the broken ramp to the marsh with the bandit hideout.
Follow the cliff wall to the right of the hideout to the shrine and interact with it.

achievements.description: Find the Winter shrine.
achievements.summary: Bow at the Winter solstice shrine in Chapter 3.

steps.text: At the start of Chapter 3, follow Iorveth through the caves and do not take the Order's camp.
At the wall you climb into Loc Muinne, take the slope on the right and interact with the shrine.
